R1.description: The functional step walks the functional-tester chain before the spawn with the tester's selection-time causes; a started tester is never retried; a one-entry chain is unchanged

R2.description: The selection is recorded in worker_route.selection; every-entry-unavailable ends at functional_tester_unavailable, every-entry-held returns the usage hold

R3.description: The tester stays outside the reviewer-independence rule whichever entry is chosen

R4.description: A Codex tester's usage record is built from its rollouts and a launched Codex tester has a telemetry row with the route's harness; the Claude tester is unchanged

R5.description: One real functional round on Codex is run by hand and recorded; guides, compatibility and roadmap state the facts in place; no new setting, option, exit code or gate
